summary: COMMEO AS (org. no. 998 239 451) is a private limited company (AS) based in Kristiansund, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2012-04-16. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 70.200 (Bedriftsrådgivning og annen administrativ rådgivning). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 3.6 m and net income was NOK 6.9 m. CEO: Bjarne Fure; board chair: Bjarne Fure. Also: LEI 549300Y28VQTDQITGC95.
